events.eventInfo:
Join us for the ultimate fall trail series. Technical single-track, beautiful lake views, and the best post-race community in Stillwater.

Location: East Side Pavilion, Lake McMurtry
Start Times: Marathon 7:00 AM | Half 7:30 AM | 10K 8:00 AM | 5K 8:30 AM

accordions.title: Registration Pricing
accordions.content:
DistanceFee
Marathon$70
Half Marathon$60
10K$50
5K$40

accordions.title: Course Maps & Trail Colors
accordions.content:
All races are out and backs starting at the East Side pavilion (Red Trail Head).

  • 5K & 10K: Yellow Trail
  • Half Marathon: Yellow & Red Trails
  • Marathon: Yellow, Red, Green, and Blue Trails

accordions.title: Packet Pickup & Camping
accordions.content:
Packet Pickup: Friday from 5-8 PM at Stonecloud Brewing in Stillwater (917 S Husband). Race day pickup begins at 5:30 AM.

Accommodations: Primitive camping is available by the East Side Pavilion on Friday night. Bathrooms are available, but no showers.

accordions.title: Awards & Swag
accordions.content:
All participants will receive a cool Finisher's Medal! Pre-registered runners receive a short sleeve t-shirt.

Awards to the top three finishers in Female, Non-Binary, and Male categories following each race.

events.eventInfo:
Oklahoma's Oldest Trail Run. Started in 1999 by Earl Blewett, carried on by the Tatur organization and race director Ken Childress starting in 2009, and directed by the Outlaw group since 2019 — the 29th annual running on April 10, 2027 is the first under Stillwater Trail and Road Runners.

Registration is open! Choose from 50K, 25K, 12K, or 5K on Lake McMurtry's beginner-friendly single-track — or take on the 12K or 25K as a Ruck division.

Location: Lake McMurtry West Recreation Area — not the East side. Apple Maps gets this wrong; use Google Maps or the directions below.
Start Times: 50K 7:00 AM | 25K & 12K 8:00 AM | 5K 8:30 AM

accordions.title: Course Description
accordions.content:
A variety of distances on single track winding through the pines and along the shores of Lake McMurtry — moderately difficult and suitable for beginners and seasoned trail runners alike. The course is a loop on the west side of the lake, with the longer distances adding an out-and-back to the east side. The 50K has about 2,600 feet of elevation gain.

  • 50K: 7:00 AM start
  • 25K: 8:00 AM start
  • 25K Ruck: 8:00 AM start, with the 25K
  • 12K: 8:00 AM start
  • 12K Ruck: 8:00 AM start, with the 12K
  • 5K: 8:30 AM start

accordions.title: Cutoff Times
accordions.content:
• East Pavilion Aid Station closes at 2:00 PM
  • Catfish Cove closes at 5:00 PM
  • Overall cutoff for all distances is 7:00 PM

accordions.title: Packet Pickup & Parking
accordions.content:
Packet Pickup: Friday, April 9, 2027 from 5:00–8:00 PM at StoneCloud Stillwater Patio & Taproom (917 S Husband St, Stillwater, OK). Also available race morning starting at 6:00 AM at the West Pavilion (Start/Finish).

Day Permit (parking pass): Required for Lake McMurtry — purchase at lakemcmurtry.org. Either show your confirmation at their office for a hang tag, or print the receipt and leave it on your dash.

accordions.title: Directions & Travel
accordions.content:
Start/Finish: Lake McMurtry West Recreation Area, 30285 Bronco Curve, Stillwater, OK 74075. Apple Maps does not give accurate directions here — please use Google Maps or the directions below.

Driving directions: From the Hwy 177/51 junction in Stillwater, head west on Hwy 51 (W 6th Ave). Turn north on N. Cottonwood Road for 3 miles, then west on E0590, north on County Road 160, and right on Bronco Curve.

Stillwater has a variety of hotel options. Nearest airports are Will Rogers World Airport (Oklahoma City) and Tulsa International Airport.

accordions.title: FAQ
accordions.content:
Are trekking poles allowed? Yes.

Are dogs allowed? Yes — all dogs must be on a leash.

Do I have to run? No — many participants walk or hike the entire race, at any distance. You don't have to be fast to take part.
